rl.name: MSA
rl.description: Master Services Agreement. Umbrella contract between a client and a supplier governing all future engagements: term and renewal, invoicing and payment, confidentiality, IP ownership, liability, governing law and arbitration.

rl.name: SOW
rl.description: Statement of Work. Project-specific document issued under a parent MSA: scope, deliverables and milestones with dates, team, fees and payment schedule, acceptance criteria.

files.text: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT. This Master Services Agreement is entered into on 14 March 2025 between Orchid Retail Private Limited (Client) and Vertex Analytics LLP (Supplier). 1. Term and renewal: three years. 2. Fees and invoicing: monthly, payable within 45 days. 3. Confidentiality. 4. Limitation of liability. 5. Governing law and arbitration: Mumbai.
